title: PW-Pruning: Phase-Aware Expert Selection for Speech-Centric Omni-Modal Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.26891v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Sparse routing reduces per-token computation but leaves the full expert bank resident in memory. We study expert pruning for speech-centric omni-modal models, where pooling calibration statistics can obscure the different expert demands of acoustic-input processing and text-answer generation. We propose PW-Pruning, a phase-aware extension of DO-ACP that constructs separate importance-weighted kernels for acoustic-prefill and teacher-forced answer tokens, then combines phase-weighted log-determinant marginal gains to select one static expert bank. On Qwen3-Omni, retaining 32 of 128 experts per layer improves MMAU-mini and MMSU accuracy over matched pooled selection by 3.20 and 4.38 percentage points, respectively, after supervised fine-tuning, averaged over three runs. Single-phase and shuffled-label controls on this public backbone suggest that semantic phase information contributes to these gains. Experiments on a non-public Qwen3.5-O

translated_title: PW-Pruning：面向语音中心全模态模型的阶段感知专家选择
translated_abstract: 稀疏路由虽然降低了每个token的计算量，但完整的专家库仍然需要全部驻留在内存中。我们研究了以语音为中心的全模态模型的专家剪枝问题，在该场景下，使用池化校准统计会掩盖声学输入处理与文本答案生成两个阶段对不同专家的需求差异。我们提出了PW-Pruning，这是DO-ACP的一种阶段感知扩展方法，它为声学预填充阶段和教师强制下的答案token分别构建重要性加权核，然后结合阶段加权的对数行列式边际增益来选出一个静态专家库。在Qwen3-Omni上，每层仅保留128个专家中的32个，经过监督微调并在三次运行中取平均后，MMAU-mini和MMSU的准确率分别比匹配的池化选择方法提高了3.20和4.38个百分点。在该公开骨干模型上进行的单阶段和混洗标签对照实验表明，语义阶段信息对上述提升有所贡献。在非公开的Qwen3.5-O...（摘要截断）
tldr: 提出阶段感知的专家剪枝方法PW-Pruning，为声学预填充和文本答案生成两个阶段分别构建重要性加权核并融合阶段加权对数行列式边际增益来选择静态专家库，在Qwen3-Omni上每层仅保留32/128个专家即可使MMAU-mini和MMSU准确率较池化选择提升3.20和4.38个百分点。
en_tdlr: PW-Pruning is a phase-aware expert pruning method that constructs separate importance-weighted kernels for acoustic-prefill and teacher-forced answer tokens and combines phase-weighted log-determinant marginal gains, retaining only 32 of 128 experts per layer on Qwen3-Omni while improving MMAU-mini and MMSU accuracy by 3.20 and 4.38 percentage points over pooled selection.
